goal: Rebuild pi-todo as a small branch-aware focus list preserving create/start/finish/block/list and the deterministic pi-swe ownership boundary.
plan: Characterization-first replacement. Remove scheduling, leases, splitting, artifacts, modal UI, startup scans, and autonomous follow-up.

tasks.title: Characterize essential behavior
acceptance: Black-box tests cover existing essential create/start/finish/block/list behavior
Tests characterize at-most-one-active and pi-swe ownership behavior

approachReasons.tdd: The initiative must begin with executable characterization before refactoring.
approachReasons.diagnosis: Current externally visible behavior and ownership decisions must be observed before replacement.

tasks.title: Define the minimal public contract
acceptance: Public actions are limited to approximately six essential operations
Contract excludes dependency scheduling, leases, splitting, artifact writing, and modal UI

tasks.title: Build the branch-aware state core
acceptance: State reconstructs correctly from the active session branch
At most one todo is active
No startup filesystem scan or autonomous follow-up exists

approachReasons.tdd: Branch reconstruction and single-active invariants need regression tests.
approachReasons.performance: The replacement must avoid startup scans and keep reconstruction bounded.

tasks.title: Add the thin tool, command, and status surface
acceptance: Essential create/start/finish/block/list experience is available through a thin surface
Surface delegates state and ownership decisions to the core

approachReasons.tdd: Public command and tool behavior should be verified black-box.

tasks.title: Replace the legacy implementation
acceptance: Legacy scheduling, leases, splitting, artifact writing, modal UI, startup scan, and autonomous follow-up paths are absent
The minimal implementation is the sole pi-todo runtime

approachReasons.migration: Replacing the legacy runtime requires controlled removal without retaining competing state paths.

tasks.title: Qualify behavior, performance, and integration
acceptance: Branch state, single-active invariant, and pi-swe ownership are verified

approachReasons.tdd: Final qualification is driven by the characterization and regression suite.
approachReasons.performance: Startup and state reconstruction must remain bounded without filesystem scanning.
